player_prompt.intro:
U tirhisa 2048 eka borodi ya {board_size}x{board_size}. Xikongomelo xa wena i ku fika tile ya {target_tile} hi ku tsutsuma tinomboro to fana!
Miphemu leyi amukeriwa: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Matayili ya kombina loko ma pengana, ku andla thamani ya wona.

invalid_move.no_change: Borodi a yi cinca - khetha ndlela yin'wana.

outcome.win: Kutlhariwa, u fikile {target_tile}! Skor ya mahala {score}.
outcome.lose: Ku hela timosve. Max tile {max_tile} - skor ya mahala {score}.
